products.name: SentinelOne Purple AI
products.note: Endpoint security AI; autonomous response; XDR platform; kill-switch capabilities

profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) that describes itself as an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. Its site presents a unified offering spanning endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection, with a Security Data Lake as a shared foundation. The company positions its platform as built for machine-speed threats, citing attacker use of AI to generate code and move faster than traditional defenses were designed to handle.

The company's primary AI product is SentinelOne Purple AI, an endpoint security tool that also covers extended detection and response capabilities. The site describes Purple AI as handling triage, correlation, and routine incident response through agentic workflows, with the stated goal of freeing analysts for higher-value work. SentinelOne describes its approach as "Autonomous Security Intelligence," capable of stopping supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse through a single lightweight agent. The company also notes recognition in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM, citing its AI-native approach to security data as redefining that category.

No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts for SentinelOne at this time.
